description: This Java class 'DefaultJobService' implements job management functionalities such as creating, updating, canceling, processing stats, and deleting jobs within the Thingsboard platform. It interacts with the database via DAO and manages job lifecycle states.

classes.name: DefaultJobService
classes.description: Service class implementing job management operations such as creation, update, cancellation, status processing, and deletion within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: saveJob
methods.description: Saves a job, setting its status based on existing jobs, and publishes an event if needed.

methods.name: findJobById
methods.description: Retrieves a job by its ID.

methods.name: cancelJob
methods.description: Cancels a job if it is in queued, pending, or running state.

methods.name: markAsFailed
methods.description: Marks a job as failed with an error message.

methods.name: processStats
methods.description: Processes job statistics, updates job status accordingly, and handles task results.

methods.name: saveJob
methods.description: Internal method to persist a job and handle event publishing and status transitions.

methods.name: checkWaitingJobs
methods.description: Checks and updates waiting jobs of a specific type.

methods.name: findJobsByFilter
methods.description: Finds jobs based on filter criteria and enriches with entity info.

methods.name: findLatestJobByKey
methods.description: Finds the latest job by a specific key.

methods.name: deleteJob
methods.description: Deletes a job if it is in a terminal state.

methods.name: deleteJobsByEntityId
